title: Tip Picker
description: Prevents overtipping by saying whether the percent is on the pre-tax or post-tax amount (with a switch), showing every preset in money that rolls to its new value when the base changes, flagging a service charge already on the bill, and holding back accidental huge tips (250 typed in the % field, 15 typed as money, 100% that doubles the bill), struck through in the summary, until they're fixed in one tap or confirmed.
